params.prompt:
Commercial-quality modern high-density pixel-art life simulation set in a fictional contemporary Korean city.

2.5D three-quarter elevated top-down open-world game perspective, consistent camera angle, believable architectural depth, layered foreground and background, clear walkable gameplay space, realistic human-scale entrances, sidewalks, roads and interiors.

Crisp deliberate pixel edges, consistent pixel density, grounded proportions, rich environmental storytelling, restrained palette, muted urban colors, warm practical interior lighting and controlled city lights.

The world looks ordinary and believable at first glance, but contains understated black comedy about work, education, money, debt, rent, investing, consumption and adulthood.

The humor must come from context and environmental storytelling rather than exaggerated jokes.

Original visual identity for Ian Growing.

Not voxel.
Not block-based.
Not photorealistic.
Not glossy 3D.
Not generic mobile game art.
Not fantasy.
Not cyberpunk.
No real brands.
No readable AI-generated Korean text.
Leave signage text areas blank for hand-authored Unity pixel text.

Use the first reference's downtown geometry and the locked residential master for connected city identity. Busy office-retail intersection with a bank branch, cafes, lunch shop, buses, taxis, delivery rider, pedestrians, crossing and signals. People in twos at crossings, one line of workers converging on a bus stop. Business windows and blank layered signs, restrained midday color, efficient and slightly exhausting. Clear sidewalks and real entrances. Use a shallow fixed orthographic game camera looking north, camera pitched down about 35 degrees, horizontal east-west edges across the frame; visible floor/top and south-facing walls, no horizon, no vanishing points. Characters about 6 heads tall; an entry is about 1.25 times standing height. Draw a single contiguous game view with open lanes; never a collage or HUD. Use small pixel clusters, asphalt slate, concrete putty, muted teal, warm oat, ink blue and restrained amber.
